d:
In this interview, we speak to Padma Shri awardee Rahibai Soma, popularly known as the 'Seed Mother of India', who shares her inspiring journey of empowering rural women and preserving traditional seeds. Despite never having attended school, she built an association of more than 3,500 women and established her own seed bank, preserving 17 different varieties of seeds. Watch the interview to know more.
